The '''B69 Elektra airspeeder''' was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] model found in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]].<ref name="VivaSpaceVegas">{{SW|url=news/viva-space-vegas-the-history-of-the-marvelous-wheel-part-1|series=Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref><ref name="HonorAndDuty">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Honor and Duty]]''</ref>

A [[Simon Greyshade's B69 Elektra airspeeder|customized version]],<ref name="VivaSpaceVegas" /> owned by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade]], shared many design similarities to the [[XJ-6 airspeeder/Legends|XJ-6 airspeeder]], including the engines located in the front of the craft.<ref name="HonorAndDuty" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The cover of [[Republic 47|''Republic'' 47]], collected in [[Star Wars: Honor and Duty (trade paperback)|''Star Wars Republic: Honor and Duty'']], shows the B69 Elektra airspeeder. The aircraft features a paint scheme uncharacteristic to Senator Greyshade's standard<ref name="FF29">{{FactFile|29|SPE 1-2|Anakin's Airspeeder}}</ref> and bears a strong resemblance to an airspeeder borrowed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. The B69 changes appearances in the actual comic, where it is shown as a more boxy craft; however, in a retelling featured in the [[StarWars.com]] article ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'', the speeder shown is the similar-looking model featured on the cover of ''Republic 47''.<ref name="VivaSpaceVegas" />
